message.content: {"drafts":[{"title":"Set up a fully local AI coding assistant in VS Code using Continue and MCP integration","body":"For developers interested in a local AI coding assistant without relying on remote APIs, there is a useful archived resource outlining how to configure VS Code with the Continue extension and MCP integration. This setup allows you to serve a local language model through an OpenAI-compatible server like Llama.cpp or LmStudio, enabling a coding copilot experience entirely on your machine. To connect Continue to your local Ollama model, you need to create a `.continue/models/llama-max.yaml` configuration file in your project. Additionally, tools such as the Playwright browser automation can be integrated by adding a `.continue/mcpServers/playwright-mcp.yaml` file. While the tutorial assumes some technical background and does not guarantee specific performance, it provides a step-by-step guide to get started. The full tutorial is hosted on Hugging Face and can be found here: https://huggingface.co/learn/mcp-course/unit2/continue-client. This approach offers a promising route for developers seeking to maintain control over their coding copilot environment locally.","fact_refs":["f1","f2","f3","f4","f5","f6"]}]}
